# Antigravity transcript provenance

`idle.jsonl` is a redacted copy of `USER_INPUT` at line 9 of
`~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/brain/<conversation-id>/.system_generated/logs/transcript.jsonl`.
`queued.jsonl` is a redacted copy of `USER_INPUT` at line 29 of
`~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/brain/<conversation-id>/.system_generated/logs/transcript_full.jsonl`.
Only receipt-relevant fields and the actual markers remain; machine paths and
conversation content are omitted.
